descriptor.name: Chief Surveyor General CSGSearch Erven
descriptor.operator: Office of the Chief Surveyor General, Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
descriptor.attribution: Office of the Chief Surveyor General (CSG); Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
descriptor.scope: National surveyed urban cadastral-reference layer; initial qualification concerns five exact parcel reads in distributed Diepsloot windows only. Discovery windows and any later 13-cell sample do not establish citywide completeness. No legal title, survey accuracy or currentness claim.
descriptor.licenceNote: Anonymous public service. Saved first-party portal metadata gives attribution and a disclaimer, but no explicit reusable licence was established. Redistribution permission remains a second-pass question.

sourceClassification.basis: First-party Erven layer description defines surveyed and Surveyor-General-approved urban parcels, not necessarily registered. geometryType is esriGeometryPolygon. These are cadastral parcel records; no sale-listing, development-proposal or planning-overlay inference is used.

identityPolicy: Exact case-sensitive PRCL_KEY namespaced with ZA-CSGGIS-ERVEN-. OBJECTID is transport-only. No geometry repair, clipping, simplification, precision reduction, offset fitting, overlap suppression or historic-row filtering.
followUps: Native CRS is declared EPSG:4148; response requests EPSG:4326 in ArcGIS x,y order. Fresh independent datum-operation/grid/epoch alignment has not been established in this initial pass. Metric analysis uses EPSG:32735 and does not prove source alignment.
Current/historic status semantics, replacement behavior and long-term native-key uniqueness remain unverified; no unproven filter is applied.
Paging, explicit absence, material overlap, invalid geometry, area completeness and actual app binding remain second-pass checks.
Public access does not establish a reusable licence. Preserve the first-party disclaimer and attribution for review.
Discovery distributed windows establish local presence, not a legal city boundary or citywide completeness.
